attempts.raw:
root = Stack([WeightsControl, NormalizedWeights, ScoresTable, RankingsText, ScoresGraphic])

WeightsControl = Control("Weights for Criteria: Native Experience, Lightweight Runtime, Delivery Efficiency",0,100,[40,25,35],$weights)
weights = [weights0, weights1, weights2]

sumWeights = weights0 + weights1 + weights2
normWeights = sumWeights > 0 ? [weights0*100/sumWeights, weights1*100/sumWeights, weights2*100/sumWeights] : [0,0,0]

NormalizedWeights = Text( "Normalized Weights: Native Experience: " + normWeights0 + "%, Lightweight Runtime: " + normWeights1 + "%, Delivery Efficiency: " + normWeights2 + "%")

nativeHybrid = [9,8,7]
tauri = [7,8,8]
electron = [6,4,10]

scoreNH = (nativeHybrid0*normWeights0 + nativeHybrid1*normWeights1 + nativeHybrid2*normWeights2)/100
scoreTauri = (tauri0*normWeights0 + tauri1*normWeights1 + tauri2*normWeights2)/100
scoreElectron = (electron0*normWeights0 + electron1*normWeights1 + electron2*normWeights2)/100

ScoresTable = Table([
  {label:"Native Hybrid", score:scoreNH},
  {label:"Tauri", score:scoreTauri},
  {label:"Electron", score:scoreElectron}
])

allZero = sumWeights == 0
sortedScores = allZero ? [] : @Sort([
  {label:"Native Hybrid", score:scoreNH},
  {label:"Tauri", score:scoreTauri},
  {label:"Electron", score:scoreElectron}
],"score","desc")

rankingsTextValue = allZero ? "No ranking: all weights are zero" : "Ranking: 1. " + sortedScores0.label + " (" + sortedScores0.score.toFixed(2) + "), 2. " + sortedScores1.label + " (" + sortedScores1.score.toFixed(2) + "), 3. " + sortedScores2.label + " (" + sortedScores2.score.toFixed(2) + ")"

RankingsText = Text(rankingsTextValue)

ScoresGraphic = Graphic("Scores Bar Chart", [
  text(10,20,"Scores by Platform"),
  rect(10,40,scoreNH*20,20),
  text(10,75,"Native Hybrid: " + scoreNH.toFixed(2)),
  rect(10,90,scoreTauri*20,20),
  text(10,125,"Tauri: " + scoreTauri.toFixed(2)),
  rect(10,140,scoreElectron*20,20),
  text(10,175,"Electron: " + scoreElectron.toFixed(2))
])
